description: DEFAULT — do not edit. Copy to custom*.json for your patterns. All .json files in this folder are loaded at startup.
usage: Create custom*.json files in this folder (e.g., hardware.json, health.json). All .json files are loaded alphabetically, merged by pattern name. Same name = override, new name = add.

patterns.name: gpu_cpu_models
patterns.description: GPU and CPU model identifiers (RTX 3090, i7-12700K, etc.)

patterns.name: software_versions
patterns.description: Software name + version number (Python 3.12, Docker 24.0, etc.)

patterns.name: service_hostnames
patterns.description: Internal service hostnames (an inference or database host on a private domain)
